data.name: Adelind
data.gender_notes: Adelind is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic elements adel (noble) and lind (linden tree). This name was often given to noble girls in the Middle Ages. The linden tree symbolizes peace, harmony, and protection. The name Adelind carries the meaning “Noble, bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adelind usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of grace and nobility, reflecting the divine qualities of faith, love, and wisdom.
data.etymology: Adelind belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adelind total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
